checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for RPC URL HTTPS Enforcement at ACTION-SANITIZE-URL
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit wallet_updateEthereumChain with rpcUrls containing HTTP-only URLs (http://evil.com). Verify rejection. 2. Submit URLs with mixed-case schemes (hTtP://, HtTpS://). Verify only valid HTTPS is accepted. 3. Submit URLs with embedded credentials (https://user:pass@host). Verify sanitization strips or rejects. 4. Submit URLs with unicode homoglyph characters in scheme. Verify normalization rejects non-ASCII. 5. Confirm error response contains appropriate error code without leaking internal details.
executable_checks: Test HTTP URL rejection: send wallet_updateEthereumChain with rpcUrls=['http://attacker.com/rpc'] and assert error response
Test mixed-case bypass: send rpcUrls=['hTtP://attacker.com/rpc'] and assert rejection
Test data: URI scheme: send rpcUrls=['data:text/html,...'] and assert rejection
Test javascript: scheme: send rpcUrls=['javascript:alert(1)'] and assert rejection
checklist.notes: Boundary property PROP-W1-B4-PRECOND-012 covers ACTION-SANITIZE-URL at the DApp-to-wallet trust boundary. Source zone: EXT-DAPP-WALLET-RPC. Related ambiguity AMB-EIP2015-01. Edges: EDGE-SANITIZE, EDGE-SANITIZE-FAIL.

checklist.title: Verify RPC URL State Correctly Captures Raw Input Before Sanitization
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Instrument STATE-RPC-URL-RECEIVED to log the raw URL before sanitization. 2. Submit various URL formats and verify the raw URL is preserved unmodified at this state. 3. Verify that no partial sanitization occurs before reaching the sanitize action. 4. Confirm that state transitions only proceed through ACTION-SANITIZE-URL.
executable_checks: Verify raw URL is not modified before reaching sanitization step
Confirm state machine does not allow bypass of sanitization action
checklist.notes: Supporting node check for PROP-W1-B4-PRECOND-012. Verifies internal state handling of URL data after boundary crossing.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for Builder Bid Parent Hash at ACTION-VERIFY-PARENT-HASH
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit a builder bid with a parent_block_hash referencing a valid but non-head block (uncle). Verify rejection. 2. Submit a bid with parent_block_hash of all zeros. Verify rejection. 3. Submit a bid with parent_block_hash of a future block. Verify rejection. 4. Submit a bid with the correct parent hash but for a different slot. Verify proper slot-parent correlation check. 5. Verify that stale bids referencing a reorged parent are rejected after chain head changes.
executable_checks: Test stale parent hash: submit bid with parent hash from 2 blocks ago, assert rejection
Test zero parent hash: submit bid with 0x00..00 parent, assert rejection
Test correct parent hash: submit bid with current head hash, assert acceptance into validation pipeline
checklist.notes: Boundary property PROP-W1-B4-PRECOND-017 at EDGE-CHECK-PARENT. Source zone: EXT-BUILDER-GOSSIP. Builder bids from untrusted external builders must reference correct chain head. Related assumption ASSUM-GLOAS-VAL-03.

checklist.title: Verify Untrusted Bid State Enforces Validation Before Any Processing
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Verify that STATE-BID-RECEIVED-UNTRUSTED prevents any bid selection or block construction until all validation edges (signature, balance, parent hash) are traversed. 2. Check that there is no code path from STATE-BID-RECEIVED-UNTRUSTED to STATE-BID-TRUSTED that skips parent hash verification.
executable_checks: Trace code path from bid receipt to bid trust state, confirm parent hash check is mandatory
Attempt to trigger bid selection with unverified parent hash, confirm failure
checklist.notes: Supporting node check for PROP-W1-B4-PRECOND-017. STATE-BID-RECEIVED-UNTRUSTED is the entry state for external builder bids.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EIP-1559 Fee Market Validation at ACTION-DECODE-FEE-MARKET
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit EIP-1559 tx with max_fee_per_gas = 0. Verify rejection when base_fee > 0. 2. Submit tx with max_fee_per_gas = base_fee - 1. Verify rejection. 3. Submit tx with max_fee_per_gas = base_fee exactly. Verify acceptance. 4. Submit tx with max_fee_per_gas = U256.MAX. Verify no overflow in effective gas price calc. 5. Submit tx with max_priority_fee_per_gas > max_fee_per_gas. Verify rejection per EIP-1559 spec.
executable_checks: Test max_fee < base_fee rejection: craft type-2 tx with max_fee_per_gas=1 when base_fee=100, assert mempool rejection
Test max_priority > max_fee: craft tx with priority=100, max_fee=50, assert rejection
Test boundary: max_fee == base_fee exactly, assert acceptance with effective_priority=0
checklist.notes: Boundary property PROP-W1-B4-PRECOND-026 at EDGE-DECODE-FM/EDGE-FM-CALC. Source: EXT-TX-SUBMITTER-RPC. Related ambiguity AMB-LONDON-03. Untrusted transaction fee parameters must be validated at ingestion.

checklist.title: Verify Fee Market Transaction State Correctly Identifies Type-2 Transactions
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit type-2 transaction and verify STATE-FEE-MARKET-TX is reached. 2. Submit legacy transaction and verify it does NOT reach STATE-FEE-MARKET-TX. 3. Submit type-1 (access list) transaction and verify it does NOT reach STATE-FEE-MARKET-TX. 4. Verify that fee market validation only runs for type-2 transactions.
executable_checks: Verify type routing: type-0 goes to legacy path, type-1 to access-list path, type-2 to fee-market path
checklist.notes: Supporting node check for PROP-W1-B4-PRECOND-026. Ensures type detection correctly routes to fee market validation.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for DataColumnSidecar KZG Proof Verification at Gossip Ingestion
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Publish a DataColumnSidecar with valid structure but invalid KZG proofs to a gossip subnet. Verify the node rejects it. 2. Publish a sidecar with proofs from a different column index. Verify rejection. 3. Publish a sidecar with correct proofs but mismatched block root. Verify rejection. 4. Verify no column data is stored or forwarded before KZG proof verification completes. 5. Test with truncated or malformed proof bytes to verify robust parsing.
executable_checks: Test invalid KZG proof rejection on gossip
Test proof from wrong column index causes rejection
Test that unverified columns are never stored in local data store
checklist.notes: Boundary property PROP-W1-B4-PRECOND-027. Covers EDGE-RECEIVING at gossip ingestion point. Data columns received from untrusted P2P network must have KZG proofs verified before any acceptance.

checklist.title: Verify Column Reception State Gates All Incoming Data Through Proof Verification
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Verify that STATE-RECEIVING-COLUMNS always transitions through KZG verification before reaching any accepted state. 2. Check that no gossip handler shortcuts exist that bypass proof verification for 'trusted' peers.
executable_checks: Trace gossip handler code paths to confirm KZG verification is mandatory for all columns
checklist.notes: Supporting node check for PROP-W1-B4-PRECOND-027. Ensures no bypass of cryptographic verification at the gossip boundary.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for Light Client Header Merkle Proof at EDGE-HEADER-TO-VERIFY
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit a LightClientHeader with a fabricated execution payload header and a random Merkle branch. Verify verification fails. 2. Submit a header with correct execution payload but branch from a different block. Verify rejection. 3. Submit a header with empty execution branch for a post-Capella block. Verify rejection. 4. Verify that absent trusted beacon block body root causes verification to fail safely. 5. Test with branch of incorrect depth (too few or too many nodes).
executable_checks: Test fabricated execution payload with random branch is rejected
Test correct payload with wrong block's branch is rejected
Test missing trusted root causes safe failure
checklist.notes: Boundary property PROP-W1-CAPELLA-LC-PRECOND-002. Light clients receive headers from untrusted full nodes. EDGE-HEADER-TO-VERIFY is the trust boundary where Merkle proof verification must prevent fabricated execution data. Related assumption ASSUM-CAPELLA-LC-FN-02.

checklist.title: Verify Execution Branch Verification Uses Correct Root and Depth Parameters
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Verify that ACTION-VERIFY-EXECUTION-BRANCH uses the beacon block body root (not block root or state root) as the Merkle root. 2. Confirm the generalized index for execution payload matches the Capella beacon body container position. 3. Verify branch depth matches the expected tree depth for the beacon body container.
executable_checks: Confirm Merkle root parameter is beacon block body root, not state root
Confirm generalized index matches execution payload position in container
checklist.notes: Supporting node check for PROP-W1-CAPELLA-LC-PRECOND-002. Verifies internal correctness of Merkle proof parameters.

checklist.title: Falsify Gas-Economic Bound on Memory Position Parameters
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct a transaction that attempts MSTORE at position U256.MAX. Verify that gas cost calculation either overflows safely or returns an astronomically high gas cost that exceeds block gas limit. 2. Attempt MSTORE at position 2^64 with maximum available gas. Verify OOG before any memory allocation. 3. Verify that no implementation allows memory allocation at positions that bypass gas charging due to arithmetic overflow in the expansion cost formula. 4. Confirm the quadratic gas formula (memory_cost = (size^2)/512 + 3*size) correctly handles edge cases near overflow boundaries.
executable_checks: Deploy contract calling MSTORE with offset=2^255, verify OOG
Deploy contract calling MLOAD with offset=U256.MAX-31, verify OOG
Verify gas metering formula does not overflow for large position values
checklist.notes: Internal pre-condition PROP-W1-B4-PRECOND-003. Primary element: STATE-MEMORY-OP-PENDING. Related ambiguity AMB-PRAGUE-MEMORY-02, assumption ASSUM-PRAGUE-MEMORY-03. Attempting to violate the gas-economic bound by finding positions that are cheap to access despite being large.

checklist.title: Falsify Memory Isolation Invariant Between Execution Contexts
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Deploy contract A that writes known pattern 0xDEADBEEF to memory[0:32]. 2. Have contract A CALL contract B. In B, read memory[0:32] before any writes. Verify it returns zero (empty initialization). 3. After B returns, verify A's memory still contains 0xDEADBEEF (preserved across call). 4. Test with DELEGATECALL: verify memory IS shared (different semantics). 5. Test with STATICCALL: verify new context gets fresh memory. 6. Test after a reverted CALL: verify caller's memory is unmodified.
executable_checks: Contract B reads memory[0:32] at start of CALL context, assert all zeros
Contract A verifies memory[0:32] unchanged after CALL to B returns
DELEGATECALL shares memory, CALL/STATICCALL do not
checklist.notes: Internal invariant PROP-W1-B4-INV-002. Primary element: STATE-MEMORY-EMPTY. Assumption ASSUM-PRAGUE-MEMORY-01. Attempting to find cross-context memory leaks through various call types.

checklist.title: Falsify Block Identifier Dual-Format Acceptance Pre-condition
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Request /block/0x followed by 64 hex chars (valid hash). Verify correct block returned. 2. Request /block/12345 (decimal height). Verify correct block returned. 3. Request /block/0x1234 (short hex, not 64 chars). Verify appropriate handling (rejection or interpretation as height). 4. Request /block/-1 (negative number). Verify rejection. 5. Request /block/latest (string tag). Verify handling per spec. 6. Request /block/0x with 65 hex chars. Verify rejection.
executable_checks: Test valid block hash format returns correct block
Test valid decimal height returns correct block
Test short hex string handling (ambiguous input)
Test negative number rejection
checklist.notes: Internal pre-condition PROP-W1-B4-PRECOND-006. Primary element: STATE-BLOCK-REQUEST-IDENTIFIED. Related ambiguity AMB-EIP3091-01. Testing with invalid inputs to bypass the dual-format acceptance.

checklist.title: Falsify PUSH Gas Charging Pre-condition
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute PUSH0 with exactly GAS_BASE gas remaining. Verify success. Execute with GAS_BASE-1. Verify OOG. 2. Execute PUSH1 through PUSH32 with exactly GAS_VERY_LOW gas remaining. Verify success. Execute with GAS_VERY_LOW-1. Verify OOG. 3. Verify that PUSH0 charges GAS_BASE (2) and PUSH1-32 charge GAS_VERY_LOW (3). 4. Verify gas is charged BEFORE any stack modification occurs.
executable_checks: PUSH0 with gas=2 succeeds, gas=1 fails
PUSH1 with gas=3 succeeds, gas=2 fails
Verify no stack modification occurs on OOG
checklist.notes: Internal pre-condition PROP-W1-B4-PRECOND-007. Primary element: ACTION-CHARGE-PUSH-GAS. Attempting to execute PUSH operations without sufficient gas.

checklist.title: Falsify SWAP Stack Depth Check Pre-condition
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute SWAP1 with only 1 item on stack. Verify StackUnderflowError. 2. Execute SWAP16 with exactly 16 items on stack. Verify StackUnderflowError (needs 17). 3. Execute SWAP1 with exactly 2 items. Verify success. 4. Execute SWAP16 with exactly 17 items. Verify success. 5. Verify that the depth check uses the correct comparison (item_number >= len(stack) vs item_number > len(stack)).
executable_checks: SWAP1 with 1 stack item -> StackUnderflowError
SWAP1 with 2 stack items -> success
SWAP16 with 16 items -> StackUnderflowError
SWAP16 with 17 items -> success
checklist.notes: Internal pre-condition PROP-W1-B4-PRECOND-009. Primary element: ACTION-CHECK-SWAP-DEPTH. Testing off-by-one in stack depth verification.

checklist.title: Falsify Stack Position-0-is-Top Ordering Invariant
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. PUSH 0xAA then PUSH 0xBB. Execute DUP1 and verify the duplicated value is 0xBB (top). 2. PUSH 0xAA then PUSH 0xBB. Execute DUP2 and verify the duplicated value is 0xAA (second from top). 3. PUSH 0xAA then PUSH 0xBB. Execute SWAP1. Verify stack[0]=0xAA and stack[1]=0xBB. 4. Execute a sequence of PUSH/DUP/SWAP/POP and verify final stack state matches expected ordering.
executable_checks: PUSH 0xAA, PUSH 0xBB, DUP1 -> top should be 0xBB
PUSH 0xAA, PUSH 0xBB, DUP2 -> top should be 0xAA
PUSH 0xAA, PUSH 0xBB, SWAP1 -> top=0xAA, second=0xBB
checklist.notes: Internal invariant PROP-W1-B4-INV-007. Primary element: STATE-STACK-HAS-ITEMS. Assumption ASSUM-CANCUN-STACK-01. Testing that position 0 always refers to top of stack.

checklist.title: Falsify Chain Switch Rejection Error Code Post-condition
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Initiate wallet_updateEthereumChain, simulate user rejection. Verify error code is exactly 4001. 2. Verify error message matches EIP-1193 spec. 3. Verify wallet remains on original chain after rejection (no partial state change). 4. Verify subsequent RPC calls still reference the original chainId. 5. Test rapid rejection followed by new request to ensure no state corruption.
executable_checks: Simulate user rejection, assert error.code === 4001
After rejection, call eth_chainId and verify original chain
Verify no pending state from rejected request persists
checklist.notes: Internal post-condition PROP-W1-B4-POSTCOND-010. Primary element: ACTION-RETURN-ERROR-4001. Verifying correct error code and chain state preservation after user rejects chain switch.

checklist.title: Falsify PTC Timing Pre-condition (75% Slot Wait)
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Trigger PayloadAttestationMessage creation at exactly 74% of slot duration. Verify it is rejected or queued. 2. Trigger at exactly 75% (7500 BPS). Verify acceptance. 3. Trigger at 76%. Verify acceptance. 4. Verify that clock skew tolerance does not allow early attestation creation. 5. Test with manipulated local clock to see if timing check uses network-synchronized time.
executable_checks: PTC attestation at 74% slot -> rejected or delayed
PTC attestation at 75% slot -> accepted
Verify timing uses consensus clock, not local system clock
checklist.notes: Internal pre-condition PROP-W1-B4-PRECOND-019. Primary element: STATE-PAYLOAD-TIMELINESS-DUE. PAYLOAD_ATTESTATION_DUE_BPS = 7500. Testing early attestation creation.

checklist.title: Falsify EIP-1559 Activation Boundary Consistency Invariant
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Query uncle block at exactly the EIP-1559 activation block. Verify baseFee is present. 2. Query uncle block at activation_block - 1. Verify baseFee is absent. 3. Verify that the fork determination is based on block number, not timestamp. 4. Test with blocks from different networks (mainnet, testnet) to verify correct per-network activation boundaries. 5. Test the fork boundary in uncle block responses specifically, as uncle blocks may have different activation semantics.
executable_checks: Uncle at block 12965000 (mainnet EIP-1559): baseFee present
Uncle at block 12964999: baseFee absent
Verify fork check uses block number comparison consistently
checklist.notes: Internal invariant PROP-W1-B4-INV-011. Primary element: ACTION-DETERMINE-FORK-STATE. Assumption ASSUM-EIP3045-01. Testing fork boundary edge cases for baseFee field presence.

checklist.title: Falsify EIP Evaluation Pre-condition for Consideration Status
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Attempt to move an EIP directly from 'Proposed' to 'Scheduled' without evaluation. Verify rejection. 2. Verify that ACTION-EVALUATE-EIP is a required transition from STATE-EIP-PROPOSED to STATE-EIP-CONSIDERED. 3. Check that no administrative override exists to bypass evaluation. 4. Verify state machine enforces the evaluation prerequisite.
executable_checks: Verify state machine rejects Proposed->Scheduled without evaluation
Verify state machine rejects Proposed->Declined without evaluation
Confirm evaluation step is mandatory gate
checklist.notes: Internal pre-condition PROP-W1-B4-PRECOND-021. Primary element: ACTION-EVALUATE-EIP. Related ambiguity AMB-EIP7773-02.

checklist.title: Falsify KZG Versioned Hash Format Post-condition
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Compute versioned hash from a known KZG commitment and verify: result is exactly 32 bytes, first byte is 0x01, remaining 31 bytes are SHA256(commitment)[1:32]. 2. Test with point-at-infinity commitment (0xc0 + 47 zeros). Verify result format is still correct. 3. Test with multiple different commitments to verify deterministic output. 4. Verify that no implementation uses keccak256 instead of SHA256.
executable_checks: Compute versioned hash of known commitment, verify byte[0]==0x01
Verify total output length is exactly 32 bytes
Verify bytes[1:32] match SHA256(commitment)[1:32]
Cross-check with reference implementation
checklist.notes: Internal post-condition PROP-W1-B4-POSTCOND-014. Primary element: STATE-VERSIONED-HASH-READY. Related ambiguity AMB-KZG-02. Testing correctness of the version byte and hash computation.

checklist.title: Falsify Gas Refund 20% Cap Invariant
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute a transaction that accumulates large refund_counter (e.g., via SSTORE clearing many slots). Verify actual refund does not exceed 20% of gas consumed. 2. Compute expected refund: min(refund_counter, gas_consumed * 20 / 100). 3. Verify with refund_counter = gas_consumed (should cap at 20%). 4. Test edge case: gas_consumed = 5 (20% = 1), refund_counter = 1. Verify refund = 1. 5. Test gas_consumed = 4, refund_counter = 100. Verify refund = 0 (integer division: 4*20/100 = 0).
executable_checks: Clear 100 storage slots, verify refund capped at 20% of gas consumed
Verify refund formula uses integer division (floor)
Test with pre-London contract to verify cap changed from 50% to 20%
checklist.notes: Internal invariant PROP-W1-B4-INV-017. Primary element: ACTION-CALCULATE-MAX-REFUND. Assumption ASSUM-LONDON-05. London reduced refund cap from 50% to 20%.

checklist.title: Falsify Verified Columns Monotonicity Invariant
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Observe a node receiving and verifying columns 0-10 for a given block. 2. Simulate a reorg or peer disconnect. Verify columns 0-10 remain in the verified set. 3. Attempt to trigger column eviction through memory pressure or cache expiry. Verify verified columns persist. 4. Verify that no error handling path removes previously verified columns. 5. Test concurrent verification: columns arriving out of order should not cause previously verified columns to be dropped.
executable_checks: Verify column set size never decreases during sampling process
After partial verification, trigger edge cases (reorg, disconnect) and re-check column set
Verify concurrent column arrivals maintain monotonic set
checklist.notes: Internal invariant PROP-W1-B4-INV-020. Primary element: STATE-DATA-AVAILABLE. The verified column set must be monotonically non-decreasing.

checklist.title: Falsify Buffer Bounds Check Post-condition
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Read buffer with offset=0, size=buffer_length. Verify no padding applied. 2. Read with offset=buffer_length-1, size=2. Verify 1 real byte + 1 zero-padded byte. 3. Read with offset=buffer_length, size=1. Verify entire output is zero-padded. 4. Read with offset > buffer_length. Verify all-zero output. 5. Verify no out-of-bounds memory access occurs in any case.
executable_checks: Read at boundary: offset+size == buffer_length, no padding
Read past boundary: offset+size > buffer_length, verify zero padding
Read entirely past buffer: verify all zeros returned
checklist.notes: Internal post-condition PROP-W1-B4-POSTCOND-072. Primary element: ACTION-CHECK-BUFFER-BOUNDS. Testing the boundary between direct read and zero-padded read paths.

checklist.title: Falsify Data Fetch to Page Render Post-condition
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Request /block/ with a valid block hash. Verify a rendered page is returned. 2. Request /tx/ with valid tx hash. Verify rendered page. 3. Request /address/ and /token/ with valid identifiers. Verify pages. 4. Simulate backend data fetch failure for each type. Verify appropriate error page (404 or 500) is returned instead of partial/broken render. 5. Verify no case where fetch succeeds but render fails silently.
executable_checks: Valid block request returns rendered page with block data
Valid tx request returns rendered page with tx data
Backend failure returns appropriate error response
checklist.notes: Internal post-condition PROP-W1-B4-POSTCOND-076. Primary element: STATE-PAGE-RENDERED. All data fetch actions should result in a rendered page.

checklist.title: Falsify DUP Read-Nth-Item Post-condition
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Push values [1, 2, 3, 4] to stack (4 on top). DUP1 should push 4. DUP4 should push 1. 2. Verify DUP reads from correct 0-indexed or 1-indexed position per spec. 3. Test DUP1 through DUP16 with known stack contents. 4. Verify the pushed copy is an independent value (modifying original does not affect duplicate).
executable_checks: PUSH 1,2,3,4 then DUP1 -> top is 4
PUSH 1,2,3,4 then DUP4 -> top is 1
Verify all DUP1-DUP16 read correct positions
checklist.notes: Internal post-condition PROP-W1-B4-POSTCOND-080. Primary element: ACTION-READ-NTH-ITEM. Testing correctness of DUP indexing.

checklist.title: Falsify RPC URL Validation Sequence Post-condition
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Provide an RPC URL where net_version returns correct value but eth_chainId returns mismatched value. Verify rejection. 2. Provide URL where eth_chainId is correct but net_version mismatches. Verify rejection. 3. Verify both calls are made (not short-circuited after first success). 4. Test with URL that returns timeout on second call. Verify proper error handling. 5. Test with URL that returns valid response format but wrong chain data.
executable_checks: RPC URL with matching net_version but wrong eth_chainId -> rejection
RPC URL with matching eth_chainId but wrong net_version -> rejection
RPC URL with both matching -> acceptance
checklist.notes: Internal post-condition PROP-W1-B4-POSTCOND-084. Primary element: ACTION-CALL-NET-VERSION. Verifying both net_version and eth_chainId are checked in sequence.

checklist.title: Falsify Proposer Preferences Broadcast Post-condition
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Assign a proposer slot and verify proposer broadcasts preferences (fee_recipient, gas_limit) via gossip before bid deadline. 2. Verify that preferences include correct fee_recipient address. 3. Verify gas_limit is within protocol bounds. 4. Test scenario where proposer preferences are not broadcast and verify builders receive no preference signal.
executable_checks: Proposer at assigned slot broadcasts preferences before bid collection
Verify fee_recipient in broadcast matches configured address
Verify gas_limit in broadcast is within valid range
checklist.notes: Internal post-condition PROP-W1-B4-POSTCOND-088. Primary element: ACTION-BROADCAST-PROPOSER-PREFERENCES. Related ambiguity AMB-GLOAS-VAL-01.

checklist.title: Falsify Fork State Determination for Uncle Block Responses
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Query uncle block at EIP-1559 activation block. Verify fork state classifies as post-1559. 2. Query at activation-1. Verify pre-1559. 3. Test with uncle blocks that were mined in a different fork context than the canonical chain. 4. Verify the determination uses the uncle block's own number, not the including block's number.
executable_checks: Uncle at activation boundary correctly classified
Fork determination uses uncle block number, not including block number
checklist.notes: Internal post-condition PROP-W1-B4-POSTCOND-092. Primary element: ACTION-DETERMINE-FORK-STATE. Ensuring correct fork classification for uncle block RPC responses.

checklist.title: Falsify Distinct Activation Timestamps Per Network Invariant
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Verify Sepolia, Holesky, and Mainnet activation timestamps are all distinct values. 2. Verify Sepolia timestamp < Holesky timestamp < Mainnet timestamp (testnet-first ordering). 3. Verify no two networks share the same activation timestamp. 4. Verify the configuration is immutable after client build (no runtime override possible).
executable_checks: Assert activation_timestamp(Sepolia) != activation_timestamp(Holesky) != activation_timestamp(Mainnet)
Assert activation_timestamp(Sepolia) < activation_timestamp(Mainnet)
checklist.notes: Internal invariant PROP-W1-B4-INV-096. Primary element: ACTION-CONFIGURE-ACTIVATION. Ensuring distinct per-network activation timestamps prevent cross-network confusion.

checklist.title: Falsify KZG Commitment Hash Computation Post-condition
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Take a known KZG commitment (48 bytes). Compute SHA256 hash. Verify the implementation uses SHA256 (not keccak256 or other hash). 2. Verify version byte 0x01 is prepended (not appended). 3. Verify the SHA256 hash is truncated to 31 bytes (dropping first byte) before prepending version. 4. Cross-reference with EIP-4844 reference implementation.
executable_checks: Hash known commitment with SHA256, verify output matches implementation
Verify byte[0] of versioned hash is 0x01
Verify bytes[1:32] are SHA256(commitment)[1:32]
checklist.notes: Internal post-condition PROP-W1-B4-POSTCOND-100. Primary element: ACTION-HASH-COMMITMENT. Verifying SHA256 is used and version byte is correctly prepended.

checklist.title: Falsify Access List Gas Calculation Post-condition
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit tx with access list containing 3 addresses, 5 total storage keys. Expected gas: 3*2400 + 5*1900 = 16700. Verify actual gas charged matches. 2. Submit tx with empty access list (0 addresses, 0 keys). Verify 0 additional gas. 3. Submit tx with 1 address and 0 storage keys. Verify 2400 gas. 4. Submit tx with duplicate addresses in access list. Verify gas is charged per entry (not deduplicated). 5. Verify access list gas is added to intrinsic gas (21000 base).
executable_checks: 3 addresses + 5 keys = 16700 gas for access list
Empty access list = 0 additional gas
Duplicate addresses each charged separately
checklist.notes: Internal post-condition PROP-W1-B4-POSTCOND-104. Primary element: ACTION-COUNT-ADDRESSES. Per-address cost: 2400, per-storage-key cost: 1900.

checklist.title: Falsify Beacon Block Validity Pre-condition for Light Client Header
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Call block_to_light_client_header with an invalid beacon block (malformed SSZ). Verify rejection. 2. Call with a block that has not passed block validation. Verify the function either rejects or the caller enforces validation. 3. Verify that block_to_light_client_header assumes input validity (i.e., the pre-condition is enforced by the caller).
executable_checks: Pass malformed beacon block to block_to_light_client_header, verify error
Verify calling context enforces block validation before header conversion
checklist.notes: Internal pre-condition PROP-W1-CAPELLA-LC-PRECOND-001. Primary element: STATE-BEACON-BLOCK-AVAILABLE. Related ambiguity AMB-CAPELLA-LC-FN-01.

checklist.title: Falsify EVMC Message Type Validation Pre-condition
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Send EVMC_CALL message to precompile module. Verify EVMC_SUCCESS or normal execution. 2. Send EVMC_CREATE message. Verify EVMC_REJECTED response. 3. Send EVMC_CREATE2 message. Verify EVMC_REJECTED. 4. Send EVMC_DELEGATECALL. Verify handling (should be allowed per EVM semantics or rejected per EVMC spec). 5. Send invalid message type value. Verify rejection.
executable_checks: EVMC_CALL -> proceeds to execution
EVMC_CREATE -> EVMC_REJECTED
Invalid message type -> EVMC_REJECTED
checklist.notes: Internal pre-condition PROP-W1-EIP2003-PRECOND-001. Primary element: ACTION-VALIDATE-MESSAGE-TYPE.

checklist.title: Falsify Precompile Gas Remaining Calculation Post-condition
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Call precompile with gas_limit=1000 and known gas cost=200. Verify gas_remaining in result is exactly 800. 2. Call with gas_limit exactly equal to gas cost. Verify gas_remaining=0 and success. 3. Verify output data is correctly set in EVMC result structure. 4. Verify status_code is EVMC_SUCCESS.
executable_checks: gas_limit=1000, gas_cost=200 -> gas_remaining=800
gas_limit=gas_cost -> gas_remaining=0, status=SUCCESS
Verify output data matches expected precompile result
checklist.notes: Internal post-condition PROP-W1-EIP2003-POSTCOND-001. Primary element: STATE-EXECUTION-SUCCESS.

checklist.title: Falsify EVMC ABI Version 6 Compatibility Invariant
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Verify EVMC module exports ABI version 6 in its metadata. 2. Attempt to load a module with ABI version 5. Verify rejection or compatibility error. 3. Attempt to load module with ABI version 7. Verify handling. 4. Verify the version check happens at module initialization, not at call time.
executable_checks: Module reports ABI version 6
Version mismatch causes load failure or clear error
checklist.notes: Internal invariant PROP-W1-EIP2003-INV-004. Primary element: STATE-EVMC-CALL-RECEIVED. Assumption ASSUM-EIP2003-03.

checklist.title: Falsify Identity Precompile Accepts-Any-Input Invariant
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Call identity precompile (0x04) with empty input. Verify empty output returned successfully. 2. Call with 1 byte input (0xFF). Verify 1 byte output. 3. Call with 32KB input. Verify identical output. 4. Call with input containing all zero bytes. Verify identical output. 5. Call with input of maximum practical size (limited by gas). Verify no content validation occurs.
executable_checks: Empty input -> empty output, success
1 byte 0xFF -> 1 byte 0xFF output
Large input -> identical large output
No content-based rejection occurs
checklist.notes: Internal invariant PROP-W1-IDENTITY-INV-001. Primary element: ACTION-ACCEPT-ANY-INPUT. Related ambiguity AMB-PRAGUE-IDENTITY-01, assumption ASSUM-PRAGUE-IDENTITY-01.

checklist.title: Falsify ModExp Input Length Extraction Pre-condition
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Call ModExp with exactly 96 bytes of calldata (lengths only, no data). Verify correct extraction. 2. Call with < 96 bytes. Verify zero-padding behavior (missing bytes treated as 0). 3. Call with very large length values (e.g., base_length = 2^256-1). Verify gas calculation handles without panic. 4. Call with all three lengths = 0. Verify correct handling (empty computation). 5. Verify lengths are read as big-endian U256 from bytes 0-31, 32-63, 64-95.
executable_checks: 96 bytes calldata: verify correct base_length, exp_length, mod_length extraction
< 96 bytes: verify zero-padding for missing length fields
All lengths = 0: verify graceful handling
checklist.notes: Internal pre-condition PROP-W1-MODEXP-PRECOND-001. Primary element: ACTION-EXTRACT-INPUT-LENGTHS.

checklist.title: Falsify ModExp Iteration Count Calculation Pre-condition
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Call ModExp with exp_length=1, exponent=0x80 (bit_length=8). Verify iteration_count=7. 2. Call with exp_length=1, exponent=0x01. Verify iteration_count=0 (bit_length=1, minus 1). 3. Call with exp_length=33 (large exponent). First 32 bytes = 0x01. Verify iteration_count = 8*(33-32) + bit_length(0x01) - 1 = 8 + 0 = 8. 4. Call with exp_length=32, exponent=0 (all zeros). Verify iteration_count=0. 5. Test boundary: exp_length=32 vs exp_length=33 with same significant bits.
executable_checks: Small exponent 0x80: iteration_count = 7
Small exponent 0x01: iteration_count = 0
Large exponent (33 bytes): verify 8*(len-32) + bit_length(first32) - 1 formula
Zero exponent: iteration_count = 0
checklist.notes: Internal pre-condition PROP-W1-MODEXP-PRECOND-002. Primary element: ACTION-CHECK-EXPONENT-SIZE.

checklist.title: Falsify ModExp Gas-to-Computation-Time Invariant
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Benchmark ModExp execution time for various input sizes against gas cost. 2. Find inputs that maximize computation time per gas unit. Known vectors: large modulus with small exponent, specific bit patterns. 3. Compare execution time across different bignum library implementations (GMP vs Go big.Int). 4. Verify that no input achieves > 10x the average time-per-gas ratio. 5. Test with adversarial inputs from EIP-2565 security analysis.
executable_checks: Benchmark large modulus (4096-bit) with exponent=3: measure time vs gas
Benchmark known worst-case inputs from EIP-2565 analysis
Compare time-per-gas across different client implementations
checklist.notes: Internal invariant PROP-W1-MODEXP-INV-005. Primary element: ACTION-EXECUTE-MODEXP. Assumption ASSUM-EIP2565-02. Attempting to find inputs where computation time exceeds gas prediction.

checklist.title: Falsify WS Checkpoint Root Match Post-condition
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Start client with WS checkpoint at finalized epoch. Provide canonical chain where block root at checkpoint epoch matches. Verify client proceeds normally. 2. Provide chain where block root at checkpoint epoch differs. Verify client terminates with descriptive error. 3. Verify the comparison is constant-time (no timing side-channel). 4. Test with checkpoint epoch = 0 (genesis). 5. Test error message includes diagnostic information for operator.
executable_checks: Matching root at finalized epoch -> client proceeds
Mismatched root at finalized epoch -> client terminates with error
Verify error message is descriptive for operator debugging
checklist.notes: Internal post-condition PROP-W1-WEAKSUB-POSTCOND-002. Primary element: ACTION-ASSERT-BLOCK-ROOT-MATCHES.

checklist.title: Falsify WS Checkpoint Fork Prevention Invariant
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Simulate a long-range attack: create an alternative chain that conflicts with the WS checkpoint. Verify the client rejects the conflicting chain. 2. Verify that conflicting finalized checkpoints are detected (same epoch, different root). 3. Verify that at least 1/3 of stake would need to be slashed for the attack to succeed. 4. Test with a chain that diverges just before the checkpoint epoch. 5. Test with a chain that diverges just after the checkpoint epoch.
executable_checks: Conflicting chain with different root at checkpoint epoch -> rejected
Client follows chain consistent with WS checkpoint
Detection of conflicting finalized checkpoints triggers alert/termination
checklist.notes: Internal invariant PROP-W1-WEAKSUB-INV-004. Primary element: ACTION-WS-CHECKPOINT-PREVENTS-FORK. Assumption ASSUM-WEAKSUB-02.

checklist.title: Falsify Access List Gas Pricing Consistency Invariant
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Deploy identical access-list transaction on multiple client implementations. Verify identical gas usage. 2. Test edge cases: empty access list, single address with many keys, many addresses with no keys. 3. Verify ACCESS_LIST_ADDRESS_COST=2400 and ACCESS_LIST_STORAGE_KEY_COST=1900 across implementations. 4. Test with maximum allowed access list size.
executable_checks: Same access list tx produces identical gas on geth vs nethermind vs besu
Verify gas constants match EIP-2930 specification
checklist.notes: Internal invariant PROP-W1-AMSTERDAM-INV-001. Primary element: ACTION-CHARGE-ACCESS-LIST-GAS. Assumption ASSUM-AMSTERDAM-01.

checklist.title: Falsify Fusaka Fork Activation Determinism Invariant
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Configure two independent nodes with identical genesis and Fusaka activation timestamp. Process identical blocks up to activation. Verify identical post-fork state roots. 2. Test block at activation timestamp - 1: verify pre-fork rules. 3. Test block at activation timestamp: verify post-fork rules. 4. Verify no node-local state (cache, config) affects fork rule application. 5. Test with timestamp exactly at activation boundary.
executable_checks: Two nodes produce identical state root at fork activation block
Block at timestamp-1 uses pre-fork rules
Block at activation timestamp uses post-fork rules
checklist.notes: Internal invariant PROP-W1-EIP7607-INV-001. Primary element: ACTION-APPLY-FORK-RULES. Assumption ASSUM-EIP7607-04.

checklist.title: Falsify Fusaka EIP Consistency Across Clients Invariant
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Enumerate all 11 core EIPs + 4 supplementary EIPs in Fusaka. 2. For each EIP, execute a test transaction that exercises the new behavior. 3. Compare execution results across all client implementations. 4. Identify any EIP where behavior diverges between clients. 5. Pay special attention to edge cases in newly added opcodes or precompiles.
executable_checks: Each of 15 Fusaka EIPs produces identical results across all major clients
Test edge cases for each new opcode/precompile
Verify gas schedule changes are consistent
checklist.notes: Internal invariant PROP-W1-EIP7607-INV-004. Primary element: ACTION-APPLY-FORK-RULES. Related ambiguity AMB-EIP7607-02, assumption ASSUM-EIP7607-03.

checklist.title: Falsify ECRECOVER S-Value Range Check Pre-condition
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Call ECRECOVER with s=0. Verify empty output (no revert). 2. Call with s=SECP256K1N (curve order). Verify empty output. 3. Call with s=SECP256K1N-1 (maximum valid). Verify either valid recovery or empty output (depending on other params). 4. Call with s=SECP256K1N+1. Verify empty output. 5. Call with s=1 (minimum valid). Verify behavior. 6. Verify the range check is 0 < s < SECP256K1N (exclusive on both ends).
executable_checks: s=0 -> empty output
s=SECP256K1N -> empty output
s=SECP256K1N-1 -> valid (if other params valid)
s=1 -> valid (if other params valid)
checklist.notes: Internal pre-condition PROP-W1-ECRECOVER-PRECOND-004. Primary element: ACTION-CHECK-S-RANGE. Testing boundary values of s parameter.

checklist.title: Falsify secp256k1 Recovery Determinism Invariant
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Generate a known (hash, v, r, s) tuple with a known public key. Call ECRECOVER across multiple client implementations. Verify identical address output. 2. Test with known test vectors from the Ethereum test suite. 3. Test with edge-case signatures (low-s, high-s boundary). 4. Verify that the same inputs always produce the same output regardless of execution context.
executable_checks: Known test vector produces correct address across all clients
Multiple calls with same input produce identical output
Edge-case signatures (s at boundary) produce consistent results
checklist.notes: Internal invariant PROP-W1-ECRECOVER-INV-001. Primary element: ACTION-CALL-CRYPTO-LIBRARY. Assumption ASSUM-PRAGUE-ECRECOVER-01.

checklist.title: Falsify Comparison Result Binary Output Invariant
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute LT with (0, 1). Verify result is exactly U256(1). 2. Execute GT with (1, 0). Verify result is exactly U256(1). 3. Execute EQ with (5, 5). Verify result is exactly U256(1). 4. Execute LT with (1, 0). Verify result is exactly U256(0). 5. Use ISZERO on the result to verify it is a clean 0 or 1 (ISZERO(result) should also be 0 or 1). 6. Verify no implementation returns values other than 0 or 1.
executable_checks: All comparison results are exactly 0 or 1, no other values
checklist.notes: Internal invariant PROP-W1-COMPARISON-INV-002. Primary element: ACTION-CONVERT-RESULT-TO-U256.

checklist.title: Falsify Comparison PC Increment Post-condition
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute a comparison instruction at a known PC position. Verify the next instruction executed is at PC+1. 2. Verify this is consistent for all comparison opcodes (LT, GT, EQ, SLT, SGT, ISZERO). 3. Test comparison instruction followed by JUMPDEST. Verify PC correctly positioned. 4. Test comparison at the last byte of bytecode. Verify execution stops (no out-of-bounds PC).
executable_checks: After LT at PC=5, next instruction is at PC=6
All comparison opcodes advance PC by exactly 1
Comparison at end of bytecode -> STOP
checklist.notes: Internal post-condition PROP-W1-COMPARISON-POSTCOND-001. Primary element: ACTION-INCREMENT-PC.

checklist.title: Falsify Metrics Endpoint Access Control Invariant
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Attempt to access the Prometheus metrics endpoint from an unauthorized IP. Verify access denied. 2. Verify metrics endpoint is not exposed on public-facing network interfaces by default. 3. Verify metrics data does not leak validator private keys, IP addresses of peers, or other sensitive data. 4. Test with default configuration to ensure metrics are bound to localhost only. 5. Verify no authentication bypass via path traversal or alternate ports.
executable_checks: Metrics endpoint bound to localhost by default
External IP access to metrics port is denied
Metrics data contains no private keys or sensitive credentials
checklist.notes: Internal invariant PROP-W1-METRICS-INV-001. Primary element: STATE-EPOCH-TRANSITION-OCCURS. Assumption ASSUM-METRICS-01.

checklist.title: Falsify Metrics Monotonicity Semantics Invariant
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Monitor counter-like metrics (e.g., attestations_received_total, validation_failures). Verify they are monotonically increasing. 2. Restart the beacon node process. Verify counter metrics reset to 0 (expected for counters) or persist (if using persistent storage). 3. Verify gauge metrics that should be monotonic (totals) are not accidentally reset during epoch transitions. 4. Verify label cardinality is bounded to prevent metric explosion.
executable_checks: Counter metrics only increase during normal operation
No unexpected counter resets during epoch transitions
Label cardinality remains bounded
checklist.notes: Internal invariant PROP-W1-METRICS-INV-003. Primary element: ACTION-INCREMENT-VALIDATION-FAILURES. Related ambiguity AMB-METRICS-01.
